department: Search & Answer Intelligence (department 2): Priya's keyword ledger (Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools, first-party only)
basis: ADR 0047 (one task; first-party data only; ESTABLISHED / EMERGING tiers with each source's numbers apart; no market volume, no difficulty, no model; PII-suspect queries dropped and only counted; the ledger handed out once and never stored, query text never persisted; record-first; its own Search Console read budget kept apart from audits'; kill switches; client tenants need Andre, Finance and Compliance; a failed source never fails the run and nothing unread is reported as zero) and ADR 0017 GSC-6. The war room's own oracle judges personal data (NFKC, digit folding, the shared lookalike fold) and volume (conservation against what the fakes served) independently of search_performance.classify_query.

scenarios.persona: a Search Console property whose query rows are spelled every odd way: unicode lookalikes, invisible and combining characters, full-width, RTL, CJK, emoji, huge, near-duplicates and duplicate spellings
scenarios.basis: ADR 0047 (normalised merge per query, near-duplicate groups, Unicode kept, no query text stored; PII-suspect queries dropped) and the suite's own clean-query tables

scenarios.persona: query rows carrying personal data and secrets: every case of the suite's attack corpus (tests/attack_corpus.py, generated, never hand-written) and drop tables, alone or inside ordinary queries, in Search Console and Bing
scenarios.basis: ADR 0047 / ADR 0017 GSC-6 (a PII-suspect query never enters the ledger, its key or any record; only counts) and the review round 8-10 attack corpus

seeds.basis: the names of the in-repo generators and drop tables the driver runs inside the service (tests/attack_corpus.py cases() / gaps() / composed_cases(), test_query_privacy_r8/r9/r10.py)

scenarios.persona: the harness's own live secrets (the access token Google just issued, the Bing key, the service token, a private-key line) served as query rows, or echoed in Google's / Bing's error bodies
scenarios.basis: ADR 0047 / gsc_client and bing_webmaster docstrings (no key, token or answer text ever logged, returned or recorded)

scenarios.persona: a property whose totals disagree with its rows: anonymised remainders, rows above the totals, zero totals, only anonymised demand, row and page caps, zero-impression rows, an exact page boundary
scenarios.basis: ADR 0047 (ANONYMISED_REMAINDER, GSC_ROWS_TRUNCATED, EMPTY_MEASURED is a measurement and not 'no demand', unattributed never negative)

scenarios.persona: Google under stress: 429 with and without Retry-After, 5xx, quota 403, timeouts, refused connections, trickled and endless bodies, malformed / truncated / mistyped JSON, repeated pages, partial pages, a token or key echoed in an error body
scenarios.basis: ADR 0047 (a source that fails never fails the run; nothing unread reported as zero) and gsc_client (bounded retries, one deadline and one request budget per read)

seeds.basis: storm scripts over the driver's steps (API_STEPS): one step per Search Console API request, the last repeats

scenarios.persona: Bing Webmaster Tools failing every documented and undocumented way while Search Console answers
scenarios.basis: ADR 0047 / bing_webmaster (400 ErrorCode bodies, InvalidApiKey, retries, the key in the URL never logged, returned or recorded; a Bing failure is PARTIAL)

seeds.basis: storm scripts over the driver's Bing steps (BING_STEPS)

scenarios.persona: the keyword ledger's own daily read cap (separate from audits'), exhausted and mixed with audits; the per-read request cap under a storm
scenarios.basis: ADR 0047 (SEO_GSC_LEDGER_READS_PER_DAY 1..12, kept apart from SEO_GSC_READS_PER_DAY so a ledger run can never starve an audit; an exhausted run asks Google nothing) and config SEO_GSC_MAX_REQUESTS

seeds.basis: cap settings named in ADR 0047 and config.py, around the default of 2 reads a day

scenarios.persona: a second request arriving while a run's first Search Console query request is in flight: the same tenant, the same request replayed, another tenant
scenarios.basis: ADR 0047 (one running ledger run per tenant: KEYWORD_RUN_RUNNING; a replay answers the recorded run; tenants never share data)

scenarios.persona: another tenant and the hub reaching for acme's ledger runs, property, Bing site or request ids
scenarios.basis: ADR 0047 (only the property Andre bound to the tenant; a request cannot name a property; Bing only for the tenant's own domain; the hub cannot run it) and ADR 0017 tenant isolation

scenarios.persona: the same keyword-ledger request sent again: twice, five times, with another body, after a restart (a request id is per caller by design: another caller is another request)
scenarios.basis: ADR 0047 (a replay answers the recorded summary with ledger: null and reads nothing; the same id with another body is REQUEST_ID_REUSED)

scenarios.persona: every switch that covers Priya engaged before a run or while its first query request is in flight; Priya restricted by the department manager
scenarios.basis: ADR 0047 (global, write, the tenant's, capability:keywords, provider:gsc / provider:bing, the lifecycle; a switch mid-read interrupts the run and discards the ledger)

scenarios.persona: an enterprise property: thousands of query rows over many pages, past the row cap, with Bing measuring thousands more
scenarios.basis: ADR 0047 (ROWS_CAP 1000 rows, the rest counted; GSC page / row / request caps) at enterprise scale

scenarios.persona: INVENTED by the war room: whole hostile properties from a grammar (grammar.priya_query_set): odd spellings, odd counts, disagreeing totals, personal-data references into the attack corpus, caps, Bing
scenarios.basis: every MUST above, on inputs nobody listed; terminals from the suite's own clean-query tables

scenarios.persona: INVENTED by the war room: storm scripts over Search Console's token and API requests and Bing's, with per-read caps and repeated runs (grammar.priya_storm)
scenarios.basis: every MUST above, on storms nobody listed
